title: Preview - 900 Clanton Cove
description:
Property Site: https://view.paradym.com/v/900-Clanton-Cove-Killeen-TX-76542/4890617

900 Clanton Cove
Killeen, TX 76542
$315,900, 4 bed, 2.00 bath, 2,168 SF, MLS# 559161

Discover a great blend of space, style, and comfort in this beautiful 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home, offering over 2,100 sq ft of living space. Nestled in a quiet cul-de-sac, 900 Clanton Cv provides a peaceful retreat while being conveniently located near local amenities, schools, and parks.

Step inside to an open and inviting layout that welcomes you with natural light and modern finishes. The heart of the home is the stunning kitchen, which boasts sleek granite countertops, ample cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances. Whether you're a seasoned chef or simply enjoy entertaining, this kitchen is designed to inspire your culinary creativity.

Adjacent to the kitchen, the spacious living room is anchored by a cozy fireplace, making it a wonderful spot to unwind after a long day or to gather with family and friends on cooler Texas evenings. The seamless flow between the living and dining areas ensures plenty of room for hosting gatherings and enjoying quality time.

The primary bedroom offers a peaceful escape, complete with an ensuite bathroom for added convenience. Three additional generously sized bedrooms provide flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. Each room is well-appointed, with nice size windows allowing for ample natural light.

Outside, the backyard offers endless possibilities—whether you envision a garden, outdoor play area, or a space for weekend barbecues. With plenty of room to create your own outdoor oasis, this yard is ready for your personal touch.

Additional features include an attached garage, laundry room, and modern lighting fixtures throughout the home. Located in a sought-after Killeen neighborhood, this property provides easy access to shopping, dining, schools, and Fort Cavazos.

Don’t miss the opportunity to own this beautiful home in a prime location. Schedule your private tour of 900 Clanton Cv today and experience all that it has to offer!

Contact us now for more information or to book your showing!

2 full bath
